BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

2. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. CPU

3. When learning Floor Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Floor Finishes.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Floor Finishes.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Floor Finishes.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Floor Finishes.

4. When learning Waste Water Disposal, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Waste Water Disposal.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Waste Water Disposal.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Waste Water Disposal.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Waste Water Disposal.

5. When learning Ceilings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Ceilings.

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ceilings.

6. When learning Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Drawing.

7. When learning Wall Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wall Finishes.

   D. Skip safety briefings for Wall Finishes.

8. When learning Building Construction Project Phase 11, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Building Construction Project Phase 11.

9. When learning Pre-cast Concrete Products, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Pre-cast Concrete Products.

10. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Input Cable Tester

11. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.

12. When learning Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.

13. When learning Fixings and Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fixings and Fittings.

   C. Skip safety briefings for Fixings and Fittings.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fixings and Fittings.

14. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Overload every socket

15. When learning Introduction to Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Fixings and Fittings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Pre-cast Concrete Products and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
